subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR require live Telegram or owner-session delivery proof before merge, or should maintainers accept source-level tests and CI as sufficient for this session-routing change?
rationale: The code path looks narrow and correct from source, but the changed behavior is user-visible session/message delivery and the PR itself says live Telegram proof is pending.

options.title: Require Owner-Session Proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: Maintainers may explicitly accept the tests and source review as enough, but they own any remaining real transport/session delivery risk.

options.title: Pause For Broader Delivery Contract
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want one canonical completion-wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent paths before landing any one path.

recommendation.title: Require Owner-Session Proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent task and subagent completion history makes this the best available owner for the proof-sufficiency and delivery-contract call.
